operations.title: The modular infinity obstruction is ternary in the affine-torsor gluing sense
operations.body: For each ordering of the weight-(1,2,3) occurrence triple, the first contradiction after a consistent pair arises from a labelled row in the deliberately delayed third orbit. Literal coordinatewise face-vanishing of one row dual is withdrawn as mistyped.

operations.title: Three delayed-orbit labelled elimination tests
operations.body: Delayed weights 1,2,3 trigger respectively at labels (direction,sheet,level)=(10,8,2),(8,17,2),(8,25,2); the triggering sheet has the delayed weight in each case, and each normalized certificate verifies lambda A=0, lambda r=1.

authority_basis.summary: Record the verified pair-first ternary obstruction while continuing the research.
